# The three major attributes of an AC contactor

[AC contactors](https://www.mutaiele.com/ac-contactor/ "AC contactor") are important components in electrical systems, especially in controlling the starting and stopping of motors and other equipment. These contactors have several key characteristics that are essential for the smooth operation of the circuit. The three major attributes of an AC contactor include the AC contactor coil, main contacts and auxiliary contacts. Each attribute plays a vital role in ensuring the efficient operation of the electrical system.

First of all, the AC contactor coil is the basic component that distinguishes AC contactors and [DC contactors](https://www.mutaiele.com/ac-contactor/ "AC contactor"). The coils are labeled A1 and A2 and are primarily responsible for generating the magnetic field required for contactor operation. Typically, AC coils are used in most applications, they are capable of converting electrical energy into mechanical energy, allowing the contactor to close and complete the circuit. This feature enables the AC contactor to effectively control the flow of current and facilitate the starting and stopping of various electrical equipment.
